WITH bucket_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt1,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_ext1,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_net1,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt2,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_ext2,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_net2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt3,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_ext3,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt4,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_ext4,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_net4,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt5,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_ext5,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_net5
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN bucket_stats.cnt1 > 1071 THEN bucket_stats.avg_ext1 ELSE bucket_stats.avg_net1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN bucket_stats.cnt2 > 39161 THEN bucket_stats.avg_ext2 ELSE bucket_stats.avg_net2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN bucket_stats.cnt3 > 29434 THEN bucket_stats.avg_ext3 ELSE bucket_stats.avg_net3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN bucket_stats.cnt4 > 6568 THEN bucket_stats.avg_ext4 ELSE bucket_stats.avg_net4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN bucket_stats.cnt5 > 21216 THEN bucket_stats.avg_ext5 ELSE bucket_stats.avg_net5 END AS bucket5
FROM bucket_stats
JOIN reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
